description: A quicker, cheaper ChainK9 check for bots that need a fast yes or no before buying a token on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc. It really buys and sells the token once on a fork of the chain, then reads the contract: honeypot, buy and sell tax, trade gas, ownership, owner functions in the bytecode, blacklist, proxy, liquidity and source checks. It skips /scan's extra trades and time-travel probes (taxes that change over time or after several sells, owner powers tried for real, transfer limits and cooldowns), so a recent full /scan is returned instead when one exists. The report's tier field says which ran. Lite results are stored, so /report returns them later too. Not charged when the address isn't a token or has no liquidity yet (422). Costs $0.005 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.

chain.description: bsc (BNB Smart Chain, the default), eth (Ethereum) or base (Base)

token.description: Token address on the chosen chain
